title: Insomnia, Sleep Disorders & Stress (Anidra / Manas Roga) — Dual-System Monograph
source: WHO Mental Health & Charaka Samhita Chikitsa Sthana
content:
Condition: Insomnia (Anidra), Anxiety & Chronic Stress (Manas Shrama).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Melatonin 3-5mg taken 30-60 minutes before intended bedtime (sleep cycle regulation). Sleep hygiene optimization (no screens 1h before bed, dark quiet room). For severe anxiety: Specialist clinical assessment.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Ashwagandha KSM-66 (500mg root extract evening - reduces cortisol and induces restorative sleep). Brahmi Vati / Shankhpushpi Syrup (calming Medhya Rasayana). Tagara (Valeriana wallichii 250mg). Ksheerabala Taila head massage (Shiroabhyanga).
Home Remedies: Warm milk with Nutmeg (Jaiphal a pinch) and Cardamom before sleep, Chamomile tea, Foot massage with warm sesame oil before bed, 4-7-8 deep breathing exercises.
Safety: Avoid excessive caffeine/tea post 4 PM.
